culture.text: American disc jockey Alan Freed, who had popularized the term "rock and roll" and music of that style, is fired from WABC radio over allegations he had participated in the payola scandal.
culture.title: Alan Freed
culture.description: American disc jockey and rock-and-roll figure (1921–1965)
